question: Who is freed from all actions by following this teaching?
premises: faithful humans practice this teaching always
whoever acts relying on it is not bound
inference: steady faithful practice of the teaching frees one from binding action
uncertainties: compound kaścidyatkiṃcitkaroti is fused and not split
plain_english: Those faithful humans who always practice this teaching are freed from all actions; whoever relies on it and does anything is not bound.
